fit-tuning.hint: Compare training performance with validation or test performance: both poor suggests underfitting, while a large training-to-validation gap suggests overfitting.

fit-tuning-01.label: The model captures useful patterns and performs similarly on training and unseen data.
fit-tuning-01.why: The model captures useful patterns and performs similarly on training and unseen data.

fit-tuning-02.label: The model performs very well on training data but poorly on unseen data.
fit-tuning-02.why: The model performs very well on training data but poorly on unseen data.

fit-tuning-03.label: The model is too simple or insufficiently trained and performs poorly even on training data.
fit-tuning-03.why: The model is too simple or insufficiently trained and performs poorly even on training data.

fit-tuning-04.label: Systematic oversimplification causes consistent error and is commonly associated with underfitting.
fit-tuning-04.why: Systematic oversimplification causes consistent error and is commonly associated with underfitting.

fit-tuning-05.label: The model is overly sensitive to its training sample and is commonly associated with overfitting.
fit-tuning-05.why: The model is overly sensitive to its training sample and is commonly associated with overfitting.

fit-tuning-06.label: A constraint or penalty that discourages excessive complexity and can reduce overfitting.
fit-tuning-06.why: A constraint or penalty that discourages excessive complexity and can reduce overfitting.

fit-tuning-07.label: Repeated train-validation splits used to estimate how consistently a model generalizes.
fit-tuning-07.why: Repeated train-validation splits used to estimate how consistently a model generalizes.

fit-tuning-08.label: A hyperparameter controlling the size of each optimization update.
fit-tuning-08.why: A hyperparameter controlling the size of each optimization update.

fit-tuning-09.label: One complete pass through the training dataset.
fit-tuning-09.why: One complete pass through the training dataset.

fit-tuning-10.label: The number of training examples used to calculate one parameter update.
fit-tuning-10.why: The number of training examples used to calculate one parameter update.
